'''1999 Charlotte Regionals''' was a Star Wars CCG regional held in Charlotte, NC in September 1999. It is known from Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d138">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 6 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' September 1999
* '''Site:''' Charlotte, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
